translation.text: https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/88-Route-change-due-to-Ontario-Line-construction
88 South Leaside – Route change, due to Ontario Line construction

The routing of the 88 South Leaside will be adjusted to accommodate the temporary full closure of Beth Nealson Drive for Ontario Line construction. 
 
88A South Leaside will be adjusted to operate between St Clair Station and Thorncliffe Park. 
 
88B South Leaside will be adjusted to operate between St Clair Station and Wicksteed Avenue via Laird Station. 
 
To accommodate local travel, temporary service on the new 156 Millwood will begin, operating between Thorncliffe Park and Wicksteed Avenue via Laird Station. 
 
Service on the 156 Millwood will operate every 25 to 30 minutes approximately between 5 a.m. and 7 p.m. on weekdays, 5:30 a.m. and 7 p.m. on Saturdays, and 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. on Sundays.

translation.text: https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/501-301-507-508-Long-Branch-Loop-Streetcar-Track-Renewal-Work
– Long Branch Loop Streetcar Track Renewal Work

With the start of the TTC construction at Long Branch Loop service will be adjusted on the following routes: 
 
501 Queen: 501A Queen streetcar will be extended to operate in the late evening period between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. Streetcars will continue to arrive every 10 minutes. 
 
Service on the 501C Queen will be suspended during this construction period. 
 
301 Queen: Overnight service on the 301 Queen streetcar will be shortened to operate between Neville Park Loop and Humber Loop. 
 
301L Queen bus replacement service will be introduced between Long Branch Loop and Dufferin Gate Loop via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road and Lake Shore Boulevard West. Buses will arrive every 30 minutes. 
 
507 Long Branch: Service on the 507 Long Branch streetcar will be suspended and replaced by 507 Long Branch bus replacement service. 
 
507 Long Branch bus replacement service will operate between Humber Loop and Long Branch Loop via Lake Shore Boulevard West, Park Lawn Road and The Queensway. 
 
Buses will arrive every 10 minutes and be extended into the late evening period to replace suspended 501C Queen streetcar service. 
 
507M Long Branch bus replacement shuttle service will begin operating between Humber Loop and Humber Bay Shores (Marine Parade Drive and Silver Moon Drive) via The Queensway, Park Lawn Road, Lake Shore Boulevard West and Marine Parade Drive.
 
Buses will arrive 15 minutes during the weekday peak periods and between 20 and 30 minutes in off peak periods. 
 
Service on the 508 Lake Shore streetcar will be suspended for the summer.
advisory image

– Route change due to end of TTC track work

Regular streetcar service will resume on the 501/301 Queen as TTC track work ends on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and Davies Avenue. 
 
The 301B Queen bus replacement service will be removed.

https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/503-Route-change-due-to-end-of-TTC-track-work
503 Kingston Rd – Route change due to end of TTC track work

The 503 Kingston Rd replacement bus will no longer divert as the TTC track work ends on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and Davies Avenue. 
 
With this change, regular service will resume on Queen Street East between Broadview Avenue and King Street East, and on King Street East between Queen Street East and Parliament Street.
advisory image
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/506-306-Route-change-due-to-City-and-TTC-construction
– Route change due to City and TTC construction

Westbound 506B/306B Carlton bus replacement service will be adjusted to divert via Parliament Street, Carlton Street, Yonge Street and Wellesley Street as the portion of Carlton Street construction ends. 
Eastbound 506B/306B Carlton replacement buses will continue to operate via Spadina Avenue, College Street, Carlton Street, Parliament Street, and Gerrard Street East. 
 
506/306 Carlton streetcars will continue to divert via Bay Street, Dundas Street, and Parliament Street while construction activities remain underway within the corridor. 
 
Please note: These route changes will not be reflected on the TTC’s Routes and Schedules pages or most trip‑planning apps.
https://www.ttc.ca/service-advisories/Service-Changes/510-310-Temporary-route-change-due-to-streetcar-infrastructure-work
– Temporary route change due to streetcar infrastructure work

October 19, 4 a.m. to October 21, 2026, 11 p.m.
 
510/310 Spadina streetcars will divert via College and Bathurst streets to Bathurst Station. 
 
510/310 Spadina replacement buses will operate between Spadina Station and south of College Street. 
 
From Spadina Station, replacement buses will serve stops at bus platforms. 
 
Transfer points: 
 
Northbound replacement buses: board at the temporary stop on the east side of Spadina Avenue, south of College Street. 
 
Southbound streetcars: board on the west side of Spadina Avenue, south of College Street. 
 
Replacement buses will serve curbside stops.
 

 
Nightly, October 19, 11 p.m. to October 21, 2026, 4 a.m. 
 
510/310 Spadina streetcars will divert via Dundas Street West and Bathurst Street to Bathurst Station. 
 
510/310 Spadina replacement buses will operate between Spadina Station and south of Dundas Street West. From Spadina Station, replacement buses will serve stops at bus platforms. 
 
Transfer points: 
 
Northbound replacement buses: board on the east side of Spadina Avenue, south of Dundas Street West. 
 
Southbound streetcars: board on the south side of Dundas Street West, west of Spadina Avenue. 
 
Replacement buses will serve curbside stops.
